decisions.reason: The online customer portal is less central than a physical display product but fits the firm's integrated execution model and information-security direction, so with sufficient organisational learning it is more likely to be retained than withdrawn.

This packaging display solution builds directly on the firm's paper-based display know-how and the 2024 packaging award is a strong signal that the firm can recognise, refine, and commercially exploit it.
A quarter-pallet cardboard pegboard display is very close to the firm's established retail-display capabilities, making it easy to absorb customer feedback and improve rather than discontinue.

A small cardboard counter display is a highly related extension of the firm's core 3D cardboard offering, so its existing design, printing, assembly, and logistics knowledge strongly supports continued marketing.

A large freestanding cardboard information display is also tightly aligned with the firm's core display business and production assets, which lowers withdrawal risk because the firm can adapt it using existing capabilities.
